--- title: "Split component at L = 2" subtitle: "Three independent effects fit with two components: one component splits across two effects, and its two-point offset distorts the gIBSS and gIBSS-GO update of the other." engine: jupyter jupyter: python3 execute: fig-dpi: 110 --- ## Design Three independent causal columns $A, B, C$ with equal effect $\beta$, $p = 50$ standard Gaussian columns, and an $L = 2$ fit. One component sits on $A$ (the clean component); the other splits between $B$ and $C$ (the split component). On iid rows a strong $B, C$ pair rarely splits, because noise breaks the tie. So the design is swap-symmetric: draw $n/2$ rows, append the same rows with columns $B$ and $C$ swapped, and duplicate $y$. Then $\text{lbf}_B = \text{lbf}_C$ exactly and the split component has $\alpha_B = \alpha_C = 1/2$ in every arm. Arms, all `fit_glm_susie` with a Gaussian variational family, `center=True`, EB prior variance capped at 100: - CAVI-Q2: the other component's offset integrated exactly (`offset_integration="cf"`). - gIBSS-Q2: plug-in mean offset (`"none"`). - gIBSS-GO: moment-matched Gaussian offset (`"lognormal"` for Poisson, `"probit_mixture"` for logistic). Every fit runs a fixed 100 sweeps. At this pin `fit_glm_susie` declares convergence on the alpha SKL alone, alpha saturates in the first sweep, and every arm stops after 2 sweeps. ## The offset the clean component sees Write $\mu$ for the split component's mean on $B$ (equal to its mean on $C$) and ignore its posterior variance. Row $i$'s offset from the split component is $\mu x_{iB}$ or $\mu x_{iC}$ with probability $1/2$ each. With $m_i = \mu (x_{iB} + x_{iC})/2$ and $d_i = \mu (x_{iB} - x_{iC})$, the Poisson expected log-likelihood of the clean component needs $$ E\big[e^{o_i}\big] = e^{m_i} \cosh(d_i / 2) \quad \text{(CAVI)}, \qquad e^{m_i} \quad \text{(gIBSS-Q2)}, \qquad e^{m_i + d_i^2/8} \quad \text{(gIBSS-GO)}. $$ gIBSS-Q2 drops the factor $\cosh(d_i/2) \ge 1$. gIBSS-GO replaces it with $e^{d_i^2/8} \ge \cosh(d_i/2)$, a Gaussian with the right variance but the wrong tails. Both errors grow with $|d_i|$, so with $\beta$ and with the spread of the columns. ## One replicate Poisson, $\lambda_0 = e^{b_0} = 1$, $\beta = 1$, $n = 500$, seed 1100. ::: {#cell-fig-one-trace .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.5, 2.6)) top = one["cavi"]["elbo"][-1] for arm in sc.ARMS: e = one[arm]["elbo"] s = np.arange(1, len(e) + 1) axes[0].plot(s, e - top, color=sc.COLOR[arm], lw=1.2, label=sc.LABEL[arm]) axes[1].plot(s, one[arm]["mu_clean"], color=sc.COLOR[arm], lw=1.2) axes[0].set_ylim(-400, 20) fin = [one[a]["mu_clean"][-1] for a in ("cavi", "gibss")] axes[1].set_ylim(min(fin + [BETA]) - 0.3, max(fin) + 0.5) axes[0].set_ylabel("ELBO - CAVI final (nats)", fontsize=8) axes[1].axhline(BETA, color="0.6", lw=0.8, ls=":") axes[1].set_ylabel(r"clean $\mu_A$", fontsize=8) for ax in axes: ax.axvline(2, color="0.5", lw=0.8, ls="--") ax.set_xscale("log") ax.set_xlabel("sweep", fontsize=8) ax.tick_params(labelsize=7) axes[0].legend(fontsize=7, frameon=False) fig.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![ELBO (Q2, shared intercept) and the clean component's posterior mean on A at the end of each sweep. Dashed line at sweep 2, where the default convergence check stops every arm. Both axes clip gIBSS-GO's excursions (its clean mean reaches about 150).](split_component_files/figure-html/fig-one-trace-output-1.png){#fig-one-trace width=703 height=273} ::: ::: ::: {#tbl-one .cell tbl-cap='Final state of each arm. elbo = Q2 ELBO; d_elbo = elbo - CAVI\'s; mu, sd = clean component\'s posterior mean and sd on A; lbf = clean component\'s SER log BF; split_mu = split component\'s mean on B; alpha_B = split component\'s alpha on B; stable = ELBO range under 1 nat over the last 20 sweeps and final ELBO within 10% of its best in sweeps 1-10.' execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} def row(arm, st, e): c = sc.components(st) return dict(arm=sc.LABEL[arm], elbo=e[-1], d_elbo=e[-1] - one["cavi"]["elbo"][-1], mu=c["clean"]["mu"], sd=c["clean"]["sd"], lbf=c["clean"]["lbf"], split_mu=c["split"]["mu"], alpha_B=c["split"]["alpha_B"], stable=sc.stable(e, head=e[:10])) pl.DataFrame([row(a, one[a]["state"], one[a]["elbo"]) for a in sc.ARMS]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ```{=html}

lo) if q != "d_elbo" or fam != "poisson" else 0.0 lo, hi = (lo * 2 - 1, hi + 1) if pad == 0.0 else (lo - pad, hi + pad) for k, arm in enumerate(arms): for b_i, beta in enumerate(betas): d = rel.filter((pl.col("family") == fam) & (pl.col("arm") == arm) & (pl.col("beta") == beta)) x = b_i + (k - 0.5) * 0.36 + rng.uniform(-0.08, 0.08, d.height) v = d[q].to_numpy() ok = d["stable"].to_numpy() & np.isfinite(v) ax.scatter(x[ok], v[ok], s=9, color=sc.COLOR[arm], lw=0, label=sc.LABEL[arm] if (i == 0 and b_i == 0) else None) # unstable fits: no meaningful value, drawn at the clipped panel edge ax.scatter(x[~ok], np.where(v[~ok] > 0, hi, lo), s=16, marker="o", facecolor="none", edgecolor=sc.COLOR[arm], lw=0.8, clip_on=False) if q == "d_elbo" and fam == "poisson": ax.set_yscale("symlog", linthresh=1) ax.set_ylim(lo, hi) ax.set_xticks(range(len(betas)), [f"{b:g}" for b in betas]) ax.tick_params(labelsize=7) if j == 0: ax.set_ylabel(lab, fontsize=8) if i == 0: ax.set_title(fam.capitalize(), fontsize=9) if i == len(QS) - 1: ax.set_xlabel(r"$\beta$", fontsize=8) axes[0, 0].legend(fontsize=7, frameon=False, loc="lower left") fig.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Each arm against CAVI-Q2, per replicate. Rows: ELBO difference (symlog for Poisson), clean component's posterior mean shift in units of CAVI's posterior sd, clean component's SER log BF difference. Open circles at the panel edge: the arm's ELBO did not settle (range over 1 nat in the last 20 sweeps, or final ELBO more than 10% below its best in sweeps 1-10), so its last-sweep value is not shown.](split_component_files/figure-html/fig-reps-output-1.png){#fig-reps width=701 height=603} ::: ::: ::: {#tbl-reps .cell tbl-cap='Medians over the settled replicates, per arm against CAVI-Q2. d_elbo = arm ELBO - CAVI ELBO (nats); z_mu = clean component\'s mean shift in CAVI posterior sds; d_lbf = clean component\'s SER log BF - CAVI\'s; unstable = replicates whose ELBO did not settle (same rule as the figure); split = replicates where CAVI\'s split component has alpha_B in [0.4, 0.6].' execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} split = reps.filter(pl.col("arm") == "cavi").group_by("family", "beta").agg( split=((pl.col("alpha_B") - 0.5).abs() < 0.1).sum()) (rel.filter(pl.col("arm") != "cavi") .group_by("family", "beta", "arm") .agg(pl.col("d_elbo").filter(pl.col("stable")).median(), pl.col("z_mu").filter(pl.col("stable")).median(), pl.col("d_lbf").filter(pl.col("stable")).median(), unstable=(~pl.col("stable")).sum()) .join(split, on=["family", "beta"]) .with_columns(pl.col("arm").replace_strict(sc.LABEL)) .sort("family", "beta", "arm", descending=[True, False, False])) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=7} ```{=html}
